'''Marie''' (Japanese: '''ツカサ''' ''Tsukasa'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP162|Type Casting]]''.

She and [[Pierre]] were trying to determine whether {{p|Sudowoodo}} was a {{t|Rock}} [[type]] or a {{t|Grass}} type. She argued that knowledge written in books is not always right. During their field research, Marie witnessed Sudowoodo perform the [[move]]s {{m|Razor Leaf}} and {{m|Vine Whip}}, which is impossible for any Rock-type Pokémon to learn, therefore she concluded that Sudowoodo was a Grass Pokémon. Eventually, they learned Sudowoodo was in fact a Rock type after noticing the wild one they were studying was afraid of water, which is abnormal for a Grass-type Pokémon. With the use of the move {{m|Mimic}}, Sudowoodo was able to imitate moves not of its type.

[[Marie's grandfather|Her grandfather]] was inspired by Marie's hope in finding a Sudowoodo and was willing to offer anyone who caught a Sudowoodo on his behalf a trip to the other side of a river with his boat.
